raw:
Agent Name: MusicHistorian_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: They incorrectly “confirmed” that Thriller was the fifth single from Michael Jackson’s sixth studio album, omitting the singles Human Nature and P.Y.T. (Pretty Young Thing) that preceded Thriller in the widely recognized (U.S.) release order. This led the team to analyze the wrong song (Thriller instead of Human Nature) and thus derive the wrong word before the second chorus.
